flags.question: Identify the first 3 addresses that are shared by multiple entities or officers.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(e:Entity)
WITH a, COUNT(e) AS entityCount
WHERE entityCount > 1
RETURN a.address AS sharedAddress
UNION
MATCH (a:Address)<-[:registered_address]-(o:Officer)
WITH a, COUNT(o) AS officerCount
WHERE officerCount > 1
RETURN a.address AS sharedAddress
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count
